:::{#exm-sensitivity}
#### The sensitivity of a one-point problem

Minimize $x^2$ subject to $x = b$, for a number $b$.
The feasible set (@def-feasible-set) is $\cb{b}$, so the minimum value is $f^*(b) = b^2$,
and its sensitivity to $b$ is $\dif{}{b} f^*(b) = 2b$.
At $b = 3$ the sensitivity is $6$:
moving $b$ from $3$ to $3.1$ raises the minimum value from $9$ to $9.61$,
an increase of $0.61$, close to $6 \times 0.1 = 0.6$.

:::
